original_gen1_audit_contract.title: Reconcile spec-to-code (gen-1) for T8.0: Enablers (GPU recipe, CI parity, test-file splits)
original_gen1_audit_contract.description:
Deep-dive review: compare the original spec/requirements (see epic description and docs/scope.md T8 row, docs/invariants.md) against the implementation delivered by sibling beads under this epic.

Mindset: audit the CODEBASE against the spec, not the sibling diffs against their bead descriptions. Your job is to FALSIFY the coverage claim, not to collect confirming evidence. A requirement counts as implemented only after you have read the implementing code; a test existing or the suite being green is never sufficient evidence by itself.

Workflow:
1. Re-read the epic description and all sibling bead descriptions/acceptance criteria.
2. Audit the code. Start from the sibling diffs, but treat the whole codebase as in scope; spec invariants bind pre-existing code too.
3. For every universal or negative requirement ("no X anywhere", "every Y must", "the only path is Z"): enumerate ALL code paths performing that operation (search the repo) and verify each one.
4. Audit the instruments: for every guardrail/scan test, read its regex, glob and scan roots and check they cover the mandated surface. For every spec scenario confirm ONE gate pins it (a behavior-executing test, or the designated scan guard for structural invariants).
5. Where several surfaces implement the same contract, diff them against each other (filters, defaults, ordering, authz).
6. Produce a checklist mapping every requirement to its implementing bead and code evidence (file:line), classified implemented/partial/missing/deviates.
7. For every partial or missing requirement, report a cold-start-ready gap candidate in Discovered-Follow-Ups-JSON (priority, parent, deps, exact spec link, acceptance evidence, gate species, expected net test delta).
8. When gaps remain, report the need for a gen-2 reconciliation and return blocked-awaiting-coordinator with "coverage gaps remain" as the unblock condition.
9. The coordinator dedupes/materializes gaps and closes lifecycle state; this worker never mutates Beads lifecycle.
original_gen1_audit_contract.design: Spec sources: docs/scope.md T8 row and Working rules, docs/invariants.md (every named test exists), docs/vision.md, plus every sibling bead under hud-bstmy.1 (their Files/Evidence lists define the deletion surface; verify each deletion grep is empty and each kept test exists). Runs last among implementation siblings. Escalation (needs-human) siblings are deliberately NOT dependencies: their default is status quo, so reconciliation must not wait on an owner answer; if one was answered, include its follow-up bead.
original_gen1_audit_contract.acceptance_criteria:
1. Every requirement in the epic spec has a corresponding implementation bead.
2. Universal/negative invariants are verified by enumerating every code path that performs the operation, not by citing a single compliant example.
3. Guardrail/scan tests were audited for blind spots, and every spec scenario is pinned by exactly one gate species; no gap candidate proposes tests for a scenario that already has one.
4. Any gaps found are reported as dedupe-ready child-bead candidates under the same epic.
5. If gaps were found, the handoff reports a next-generation reconciliation candidate.
6. The close reason records the reconciliation summary.

gen2_acceptance_contract:
1. The report identifies an exact audit commit and rereads hud-bstmy.1, original children .1.1-.1.5, gen-1 .1.6, corrections .1.7-.1.10, later relevant children including .1.12, and current docs/scope.md T8/Working rules, docs/vision.md, docs/invariants.md and AGENTS.md. No original scope or criterion is dropped.
2. Every T8.0 requirement has an implementing-bead/code/gate/evidence row classified implemented, partial, missing or deviates. Split history preserves the original 275/135 test inventories and bodies at the delivered commits; old monolithic files remain absent, topic modules are wired, and the original compositor file-size criterion and named invariant retention are assessed with later edits explained.
3. Universal inventories cover every shippable workspace default-feature closure, every relevant raw/indirect/macro GPU initialization site, every GPU-building recipe, every CI run step and every docs/invariants.md named test. Single-test exceptions are proven per binary. A single compliant path is never used to establish a universal claim.
4. Guard code and fixture scope are audited for blind spots. The exact just/CI metadata command passes real metadata; existing clean/negative/repeated-edge/missing-shipped-package fixture cases execute and assert exit behavior. Any uncovered counterexample is documented without editing manifests. Redundant LTO build/reference deletions and unchanged required job display name are verified.
5. GPU construction serialization and actual llvmpipe ICD selection are independently checked. Dry-runs cover both calibration invocations and every GPU recipe, including any new ones; selected-path discovery supports both Mesa filenames. just test-gpu executes twice under its required-GPU/900-second contracts, or the exact failed/unavailable proof is reported as a limitation, never coverage from skipped tests.
6. Every ci.yml run step is reachable through just --dry-run ci or explicitly named/classified as excluded. Integration, Python/orphan-script, token-footprint, boot, Windows-GNU clippy, cargo-deny and pwsh paths are traced, semantic differences are reported, and just ci is executed once where possible. SKIPPED tool gates and informational/weekly exclusions remain visible in the evidence.
7. README.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, justfile and CI comments are assessed against actual GPU inclusion, pixel_readback feature unification, complete recipe mapping and skip semantics. Stale text yields precise proposed corrections; no documentation or spec write occurs in this read-only pass.
8. hud-bstmy.8.6's recorded owner answer and delivered follow-up are assessed when present. Without an answer, status quo/no workflow or ruleset changes is recorded and the audit does not wait for owner approval. The duplicate informational pixel-readback job is distinguished from existing blocking test-unit coverage.
9. Every audited scenario is pinned by one adequate gate species, and guard scan roots/regexes/globs/eligibility predicates are checked against the full required surface. Gap proposals extend the nearest existing adequate gate; they never add redundant tests merely to prove already-executed behavior. This audit's own net test/code delta is zero.
10. Partial/missing/deviating coverage and documentation discrepancies are reported as cold-start-ready, dedupe-ready Discovered-Follow-Ups-JSON candidates under hud-bstmy.1 with the specified dependencies/spec/evidence/gate/net-test-delta fields; existing open .1.12 and other overlapping work are linked instead of duplicated.
11. If gaps remain, the handoff reports blocked-awaiting-coordinator, unblock condition coverage gaps remain, and one gen-3 candidate with proposed blockers. No gen-4 is proposed. If complete, the handoff supplies a coverage summary the coordinator can use as the close reason.
12. No code, tests, manifests, recipes, workflows, product docs/specs, rulesets or Beads lifecycle are changed. Writes are limited to the authorized audit/coordinator handoff and ordinary generated/ignored build, test-evidence and scratch verification artifacts; failures, skipped checks and pending evidence are explicitly disclosed.
13. Durable evidence report is committed, pushed and submitted as an evidence-only PR; coordinator confirms merge before closure and keeps the bead blocked if gaps remain.
